job.job_title: Coforge Ltd is Hiring Senior AI Engineer | GenAI, LLM & Agentic AI
job.job_description:
Coforge Ltd. is seeking Senior AI Engineers with expertise in GenAI, LLMs, and Agentic AI for our teams located in Greater Noida, Pune, and Hyderabad.





Experience: 6 to 8 Years




Job Location: Greater Noida, Pune & Hyderabad Only




Employment Type: Full-Time




Email: Gaurav.2.Kumar@coforge.com




If you have any questions regarding this opportunity, please feel free to contact us on




WhatsApp at: 9667427662 ( Gaurav Kumar HR, Coforge Ltd )






Key Responsibilities:





• Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML and GenAI solutions in production environments.
• Build and optimize Agentic AI systems, LLM-powered applications, and recommendation engines.
• Develop scalable AI architectures, APIs, and model versioning frameworks.
• Implement distributed training, model evaluation, and performance optimization techniques.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-performance AI solutions.





Required Skills:




• Strong programming expertise in Python, C++, Java, or Scala.
• Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.
• Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face, and OpenCV.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms: Azure, AWS, or GCP.
• Knowledge of GPU Computing tools such as CUDA, Rapids, and NeMo.
• Experience building production-grade AI systems, Microservices, and APIs.





Good to Have:




• Neo4j, Knowledge Graphs
• Spark, Kafka, Redis, Elasticsearch
• Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform
• Experience with Real-Time AI/GenAI Systems and Responsible AI





Preferred Qualifications:




• Experience in Agentic AI, Reasoning Systems, Digital Twins, or Decision Intelligence.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.
